title: test(dogfood): take the admin search terms from rows the stock admin is served
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXuamRUC67fx2TTYrFfyuSH)_

Fixes #33429

Clause-②: no — a test-only change in the private `@objectstack/dogfood` package; nothing publishes.
Metadata-protocol: none

## Maintainer quick read

- What changes: one dogfood test now picks its search words from rows the admin can actually see, so it stops failing at random in the merge queue.
- Why: it ejected #33364 and #33409 from the queue. It is not a product bug. Sometimes the word it picked came from an activity row about an internal object (`sys_oauth_resource`) that no one is allowed to read through the data API, so the admin's search correctly found nothing.
- Risk and rollback: test only. Rollback is a revert.
- Needed from you: nothing.

## Cause (measured locally on the stock showcase boot)

- The test took its term from `ql.find(table, { limit: 1 })` under the system context, with no sort. That row varied between boots: four boots gave `showcase_invoice_line`, `showcase_expense_line`, `showcase_task` and `sys_oauth_resource`.
- The boot writes one `sys_activity` row about `sys_oauth_resource` (the MCP resource registration, no actor). `GET /data/sys_oauth_resource` answers 404 `OBJECT_API_DISABLED`, and the activity read gate serves a row only to a reader who can read its parent, so the stock admin is served none of that object's activity rows.
- A probe over every `object_name` the boot wrote: the admin's `$search` and its `$filter` on the name both answer more than 0 rows for every name except `sys_oauth_resource`, where both answer 0. When that row came first, line 96 saw 0. Both victims failed on that assertion, not on a timeout.

No wait or retry is added.

## What changes

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/audit-log-admin-search.dogfood.test.ts`: each term is the `object_name` of the newest row the stock admin reads through the same data door (`$orderby=created_at desc` on `sys_audit_log`, `timestamp desc` on `sys_activity`, `$top=1`). The armed control and the comment say so.

## Verification

- The changed file, run 3 times on a built tree: 3/3 passed each run.
